diagnostic.method: Inclusive method wrappers and cheap per-draw snapshots add observer overhead. This is a latency attribution diagnostic, not formal before/after timing. Follow with the unchanged non-profiled harness for formal results.

assetCoverage.name: mixed-large-creatures-golems-siege
assetCoverage.arrangement: 20 kinds with five instances each: idle, walk, attack, cast for compatible casters (attack otherwise), and retained attack direction with idle/walk. Owner alternates by instance group, so every kind appears on both teams.
assetCoverage.actionFacts: Deterministic release facts and displacement only; no simulation advances in presentation samples. Attacks and casts target positions of another visible unit. Targets may be distant because this is an asset streaming probe, not combat validation.

cycles.scope: Controlled mixed 20-kind / 100-visible-unit presentation fixture, no simulation or combat execution. Full authored density 4 and original tile/mip/lighting/shadow paths. WorldPresentation production actor WebGL + ground Canvas + overlay Canvas. CPU samples disable renderer.render only; real Canvas submission and other resource work remain. Snapshot construction, simulation, capture, GC are excluded. Canvas deferred work and GPU completion are separately represented by real complete-wall samples; complete wall includes fence polling/event-loop scheduling, not GPU timer-query duration or hardware FPS.

variant.name: latency-baseline-native
variant.setup: World3DLayer.create, before prepare/first draw; cached card and remains maxTextureBanks set directly; no per-frame observer

latencyProfile.scope: Diagnostic inclusive synchronous wrappers, not formal timing. Nested timings overlap; do not sum them. performance.now/aggregation/row bookkeeping add observation overhead. World layer excludes Canvas passes and true GPU completion; renderer calls include submission/backpressure, not pure GPU duration. The frozen fixture deliberately replaces renderer.render with a no-op during CPU warmup/samples; these rows report rendererRenderHookActive=false. No extra stats() calls, card traversal, GL calls, paints, uploads or rendering are introduced. Snapshot serialization/SHA happens only after each cycle, outside timed draws.
latencyProfile.snapshotHashDefinition: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(original snapshot), calculated after cycle; rows reference snapshot index, not a rewritten/render-mutated fixture. Raw final visible facts remain in harness pixelProof.

method: DIAGNOSTIC WITH OBSERVER OVERHEAD, NOT FORMAL TIMING. Inclusive method costs overlap and are not additive. Same-source joint bank/mip configuration ablation, not a historical-renderer before/after claim. Reference uses stable production order with one bank and full original mips; it skips residentMip SVD, favoring reference CPU cost. Candidate uses up to eight banks and conservative native original-mip residency. Variant setup precedes prepare/first draw; resource metadata is collected only by untimed counter calls. Mixed 20 authored kinds, 100 visible units in idle/walk/attack/cast/carry groups, hidden populations 0, 2 independent WorldPresentation lifetimes per population. Preparation performs 18 real draws at n=0..51 then 60 CPU warmup frames; this does not prewarm every later pose. 60 paced=true measured CPU frames from n=114, one fresh snapshot per three frames. CPU samples disable renderer.render only: rasterization, texture transfers and possible driver backpressure remain. 12 real three-pass frames begin at n=480; with mixed cpuFrames=60, this deliberately preserves the original fixture's n=173->480 pose-streaming jump (~5.1 seconds), including its first cold-stream sample. Full presentation and nested World3DLayer costs are not additive. Real complete wall includes Canvas work, GPU fence completion and event-loop scheduling, not GPU timer-query duration or hardware FPS. Camera blank/return images and same-source facts are verified strictly. Snapshot construction, simulation, capture and GC are outside measured draws.
